title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Key Work Points of the People's Courts for 2022
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the 2022 Work Priorities of the People's Courts

Fa Fa [2022] No. 6

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The 2022 Work Priorities of the People's Courts are hereby issued for your earnest implementation.

January 20, 2022

2022 Work Priorities of the People's Courts

2022 is an important year as China embarks on the new journey of fully building a modern socialist country and striving for the second centenary goal. Our Party will convene its 20th National Congress. People's courts at all levels must be guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, fully implement the guiding principles of the 19th CPC National Congress and all previous plenary sessions, earnestly implement the guiding principles of the Central Economic Work Conference and the Central Conference on Political and Legal Affairs, strengthen the "Four Consciousnesses," fortify the "Four Confidences," and achieve the "Two Upholds." They must carry forward the great founding spirit of the Party, continuously improve their political judgment, political understanding, and political execution capabilities, deeply study and comprehend the decisive significance of the "Two Establishments," remain true to the Party's original aspiration and founding mission, firmly adhere to the Party's absolute leadership over judicial work, closely focus on the goal of "ensuring that the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case," adhere to the general principle of pursuing progress while ensuring stability, closely follow the mainline of welcoming the 20th National Congress and studying, publicizing, and implementing its guiding principles, persist in serving the overall situation, delivering justice for the people, and upholding impartial justice, deepen judicial system reform and the construction of smart courts, strive to promote high-quality development of judicial work in the new era, and endeavor to build a higher level of Safe China and Rule-of-Law China, welcoming the successful convening of the Party's 20th National Congress with concrete actions.

I. Thoroughly Study and Implement the Guiding Principles of the Sixth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee, and Continuously Draw Wisdom and Strength from the Party's Major Achievements and Historical Experience Over the Past Century

1. Deeply study and comprehend the decisive significance of the "Two Establishments." Consistently regard resolutely achieving the "Two Upholds" as the primary task, strengthen loyalty education, strictly enforce political discipline, and always maintain a high degree of alignment with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core in thought, politics, and action. Unremittingly use Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era to arm the mind, guide practice, and promote work, deeply understand the strategic thoughts and innovative concepts of the "Ten Clarities," and effectively transform the Party's innovative theories into the ability to respond to risks and challenges and promote the development of people's judicature. Bear in mind that Party leadership is the soul of the socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics, firmly adhere to the Party's absolute leadership over judicial work, clearly take a political stance, be adept at observing and handling issues from a political perspective, planning and promoting judicial work, and effectively unify the emphasis on politics and law, ensuring that the Party's leadership is implemented throughout the entire process and in all aspects of the work of the People's Courts. Strictly implement the Regulations of the Communist Party of China on Political and Legal Work, earnestly implement the system of reporting on major matters, and ensure that the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee are implemented without compromise in the People's Courts.

2. Truly learn, truly believe, and diligently practice Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law. Continuously exert efforts in truly learning, truly believing, and diligently practicing Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, achieving integration of learning, thinking, and comprehension, and unity of knowledge, belief, and action, striving to create a higher level of socialist judicial civilization and better advance the construction of the socialist rule of law system with Chinese characteristics. Continuously promote the integration of Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law into textbooks, classrooms, and minds, strengthen research and interpretation, implement full-staff training, and vividly tell about its practical application, allowing the vast majority of judicial officers to profoundly feel the power of thought and enhance their confidence in the path. Deeply implement the youth theoretical learning improvement project, consolidate and expand the achievements of youth theoretical learning groups, strengthen education and training for new judicial personnel, guide young cadres to fasten the "first button" of their dedication to the people's judicial cause, and cultivate batch after batch of firm believers and faithful practitioners of Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law.

3. Deeply practice the people-centered development philosophy. Uphold the primacy of the people, thoroughly understand basic questions such as "Who am I, for whom do I work, and on whom do I rely," and always take realizing, safeguarding, and developing the fundamental interests of the vast majority of the people as the starting point and foothold. Carry forward the red gene, promote the fine traditions of people's judicature, improve measures for justice for the people, facilitate the fair, efficient, and substantive resolution of disputes for the masses, deeply carry out the creation activity of "Model Courts for Doing Practical Things for the Masses," and strive to solve the urgent, difficult, and anxious problems encountered by the people in litigation. Practice whole-process people's democracy, safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the people, strengthen judicial protection of human rights, promote social fairness and justice, and fully protect the people's rights to participate in and supervise judicial activities in accordance with the law. Enhance feelings for the masses, continuously improve the ability to handle contradictions among the people under the new situation, and truly deeply root the mass viewpoint and the mass line in thought and implement them in action.

II. Fully Leverage Judicial Functions to Better Serve the Overall Work of the Party and the State

4. Resolutely safeguard national security and social stability. Severely punish crimes such as infiltration, subversion, and destruction in accordance with the law, lawfully punish various types of criminal offenses, and resolutely defend national political security and overall social stability. Normalize the fight against organized crime and deep-rooted evil forces, improve long-term mechanisms, and prevent the resurgence of criminal syndicates. Maintain a high-pressure posture in punishing corruption crimes, improve the connection mechanism between disciplinary inspection and criminal justice, implement the opinion on punishing both bribe givers and takers, increase the intensity of punishing bribery crimes, and actively cooperate with international anti-corruption fugitive repatriation and asset recovery efforts. Severely crack down on serious violent crimes such as homicide, robbery, and crimes involving guns and explosives, severely punish crimes related to epidemics, crimes of major liability accidents, major economic crimes, cross-border crimes, cybercrimes, and other crimes concerning the vital interests of the people, and promote comprehensive drug management. Severely punish tax-related illegal crimes, improve judicial policies, strengthen the connection and cooperation between law enforcement and judicature, and establish a correct orientation for paying taxes according to law. Properly handle economic crimes involving a large number of victims, adhere to the equal emphasis on adjudication according to law, recovery of stolen goods and compensation for losses, and maintaining stability. Uphold the unity of punishing crimes and protecting human rights, implement the principles of legality for crimes and punishments, presumption of innocence, and adjudication based on evidence. Improve the mechanism for preventing wrongful convictions and the normalization mechanism for correcting such cases; if the original judgment was erroneous and infringed upon personal rights and property rights and meets the conditions for state compensation, compensation shall be paid in a timely manner in accordance with the law.

5. Foster a market-oriented, law-based, and internationalized business environment. Continue to ensure the implementation of the opinions on serving the acceleration of the improvement of the socialist market economy system in the new era. Adhere to the "Two Unswerving" principles, continuously improve the judicial protection system for property rights, ensure that all types of market entities equally use production factors according to law, participate in market competition openly, fairly, and impartially, and receive equal protection under the law. Strengthen the legal awareness and contractual spirit of market entities, and lawfully punish malicious arrears of accounts and evasion of debts. Strengthen anti-monopoly and anti-unfair competition judicature, clarify the criteria for determining unfair competition behaviors, and serve the construction of a national unified market that is efficient and standardized, fair competition, and fully open. Strengthen administrative adjudication work, improve diversified resolution mechanisms, promote substantive resolution and source governance of administrative disputes, and serve the construction of a law-based government.

6. Serve accelerating the construction of a new development pattern. Based on coordinating epidemic prevention and control with economic and social development, earnestly implement the Guiding Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Fully Leveraging Judicial Functions to Assist the Development of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises, truly help small and medium-sized enterprises reduce burdens, alleviate difficulties, and resume development, and continue to serve the work of ensuring stability on the six fronts and security in the six areas. Serve deepening supply-side structural reform, improve the mechanism for the rescue and exit of market entities, and increase the intensity of adjudicating bankruptcy reorganization cases. Lawfully adjudicate disputes in the fields of production, distribution, circulation, and consumption, promote the sustained recovery of consumption and the expansion of effective investment, and serve to smooth the domestic economic cycle. Severely punish crimes in the financial sector, strengthen the construction of the Beijing and Shanghai Financial Courts, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of financial consumers, investors, and financial institutions according to law, and assist in preventing and resolving financial risks. Improve judicial measures to support the construction of the Guangdong-Macao In-Depth Cooperation Zone in Hengqin and the Qianhai Shenzhen-Hong Kong Modern Service Industry Cooperation Zone, and promote the alignment and connection of judicial rules and mechanisms between the cooperation zones and Hong Kong and Macao. According to local conditions, serve the implementation of major regional strategies such as the coordinated development of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, and the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin, and better serve the coordinated development of the eastern, central, western, and northeastern regions. Promptly and efficiently resolve disputes related to the Winter Olympics according to law, and serve to host a simple, safe, and splendid Winter Olympics and Winter Paralympics.

7. Serve innovation-driven development. Increase judicial protection for key core technologies that are "bottleneck" issues, and serve the construction of an innovative country and a world-leading power in science and technology. Implement the judicial interpretation on new plant variety rights, and strengthen judicial protection for germplasm resource security. Deepen the reform of the mechanism for appellate adjudication of intellectual property cases at the national level, strengthen the construction of intellectual property courts and intellectual property tribunals, and improve the trial system featuring specialized adjudication, centralized jurisdiction, and streamlined procedures. Deepen the "Three-in-One" reform of intellectual property case adjudication, improve the mechanism for ascertaining technical facts, and promote the improvement of litigation systems that conform to the rules of intellectual property case adjudication. Improve judicial protection rules for intellectual property in new fields and new business formats, and punish illegal acts that hinder innovation such as "patent traps" and "patent trolls." Continuously promote the resolution of problems in safeguarding intellectual property rights, such as "difficulty in providing evidence, long cycle, low compensation, and high cost," and implement the punitive damages system.

8. Serve the healthy development of the digital economy. Lawfully adjudicate disputes related to the construction of new infrastructure, and serve the digital transformation of various economic and social fields during the "14th Five-Year Plan" period. Better coordinate data development and utilization, privacy protection, and public security, improve judicial protection mechanisms for data property rights and data privacy, and promote the creation of an open, healthy, and secure digital ecosystem. Adhere to regulation in development and development in regulation, properly adjudicate cases involving data transactions, unfair competition in data markets, and resolutely correct behaviors that harm the interests of the people or impede fair competition. Clarify the main responsibilities and obligations of platform enterprises through impartial judgments, protect the rights and interests of platform workers and consumers according to law, and promote the standardized and healthy development of the platform economy.

9. Promote harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. Deeply practice the concept that lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets, adhere to the strictest systems and most stringent legal measures to protect the ecological environment, comprehensively apply systems such as environmental protection injunctions and punitive damages, and serve the comprehensive green transformation of economic and social development. Correctly understand and grasp the carbon peak and carbon neutrality goals, and lawfully and properly adjudicate cases involving carbon rights and cases related to energy structure adjustment in key regions. Adhere to the integrated protection and systematic governance of mountains, waters, forests, farmlands, lakes, grasslands, deserts, and glaciers, strengthen judicial protection of biodiversity, and promote the ecological protection and systematic governance of major rivers such as the Yangtze and Yellow Rivers. Build a specialized system of environmental justice, improve adjudication rules for environmental public interest litigation and ecological environmental damage compensation litigation, and enhance the professional capacity of environmental resource adjudication. Deepen watershed and regional judicial cooperation and coordinated ecological environmental governance, and build a multi-governance environmental governance system.

10. Safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the people. Correctly understand and grasp the strategic goal and practical path of achieving common prosperity, and serve to promote common prosperity in high-quality development based on judicial functions. Lawfully adjudicate cases in the areas of education, medical care, elderly care, childcare, social security, and other livelihood fields, increase protection of the rights and interests of groups such as college graduates, migrant workers, and flexible employees, and protect the right of workers to fair employment. Strengthen the protection of housing consumers' legitimate rights and interests, and promote the virtuous cycle and healthy development of the real estate industry. Strengthen judicial protection of the rights and interests of the elderly, explore the establishment of early warning, investigation, and mediation mechanisms for disputes involving the elderly, and serve the work on aging in the new era. Strengthen judicial protection of minors, correctly implement the Family Education Promotion Law, and make good use of family education guidance orders. Improve the judicial assistance mechanism, strengthen coordination and linkage with social assistance, and promote the improvement of a more equitable social assistance system. Increase efforts to resolve petitions involving legal issues, promptly and locally address the lawful and reasonable demands of petitioners, and strive to resolve conflicts and disputes at the grassroots level and in their infancy. Practice and promote core socialist values, deeply integrate them into the reasoning of judgments, and guide the whole society to enhance legal awareness, public awareness, and rule awareness.

11. Serve the expansion of high-level opening up. Adhere to the coordinated advancement of domestic rule of law and foreign-related rule of law, accelerate the improvement of the quality and efficiency of foreign-related judicature, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties according to law, and promote trade and investment liberalization and facilitation. Improve the one-stop diversified resolution mechanism for international commercial disputes, and strive to build a new highland for international commercial dispute resolution. Strengthen the construction of the maritime adjudication system. Accelerate the training and reserve of foreign-related legal talents. Deepen international judicial exchanges and cooperation, and serve to promote the building of a community with a shared future for mankind.

III. Consolidate and Improve the Quality and Efficiency of Adjudication and Enforcement and Judicial Credibility, Continuously Enhance the People's Sense of Fulfillment of Judicial Fairness

12. Firmly establish correct judicial concepts in the new era. Consolidate the achievements of rectifying judicial concepts, improve correct concepts in practice, and use correct concepts to guide judicial practice. In criminal adjudication, accurately grasp the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity, accurately apply the criminal incidental civil mediation system, and take into account national law, natural justice, and human feelings. Correctly apply the system of leniency for those who confess and accept punishment, ensure lawful conviction and sentencing, protect the litigation rights of the parties, fully respect sentencing recommendations, and resolutely correct in accordance with the law those that violate the principle of proportionality between crime, responsibility, and punishment, ensuring fair adjudication. In civil adjudication, distinguish right from wrong, punish evil and promote good, balance interests, resolve disputes and settle litigation, firmly say no to "muddying the waters" practices, establish "clear rules" and break "unspoken rules." In administrative adjudication, enhance the awareness of the overall situation, support and supervise administrative organs in exercising their powers according to law, strengthen legality review, and at the same time resolutely prevent judicature from replacing administration, being in place without overstepping. Integrate combating crime with protecting human rights, pursuing efficiency with achieving justice, the purpose of law enforcement with its form, substantive justice with procedural justice, and strive to achieve the best legal, political, and social effects.

13. Focus on solving deep-seated problems affecting judicial fairness. Consolidate the achievements of rectifying the practice of refusing to file cases at the end of the year, and continuously optimize case-filing litigation services. Consolidate the achievements of rectifying the irregular exercise of discretion and illegal "exceeding trial deadlines." Consolidate the achievements of rectifying irregularities and illegal handling of commutation, parole, and temporary service outside prison cases, and implement the opinions on substantive adjudication of commutation and parole cases.

14. Improve the quality of judgments. Strictly control the production of judgments, ensure a firm grasp of facts, application of law, reasoning, and textual proofreading at every stage, reflecting correct value orientation. Strictly control the publication of judgments online, adhere to promoting fairness and building credibility through openness, strictly implement system requirements and technical specifications, and ensure that the publication of judgments is standardized, safe, and efficient. Strengthen faith and conviction, cultivate a deep sense of serving the people, lay a solid legal foundation, increase social experience, accumulate cultural depth, exert judicial wisdom, and strive to create great judgments that conform to the spirit of the times, meet the expectations of the people, and guide the direction of rules.

15. Strengthen judicial checks and oversight. Deepen the comprehensive and coordinated reform of the judicial responsibility system, improve and perfect the judicial responsibility system with clear rights and responsibilities, unified rights and responsibilities, effective supervision, and strong guarantees. Strengthen trial supervision and management, enforce the responsibilities of court presidents and division chiefs, implement the supervision and management mechanism for the "four types of cases," and implement principles such as organized exercise of power and full recording throughout the process. Accelerate the construction of a systematic, complete, standardized, and efficient judicial oversight and checks system, organically integrate internal Party supervision, People's Congress supervision, democratic supervision, procuratorial supervision, social supervision, public opinion supervision, and internal supervision, and enhance the synergy and effectiveness of supervision. Ensure judicial fairness, integrity, efficiency, and authority through a sound supervision and management mechanism, an effective power balance mechanism, and a serious accountability mechanism.

16. Consolidate and expand the achievements of solving the difficulties in enforcement. Accelerate the promotion of comprehensive and source governance of enforcement difficulties, thoroughly implement the requirements of Document No. 1 (2019) of the Central Committee for Comprehensive Law-Based Governance, and continuously improve linkage mechanisms such as online enforcement investigation and control and joint disciplinary action against dishonest judgment debtors. Deepen the "Double Investigation of Cases," normalize the concentrated rectification of prominent issues in the enforcement field, closely monitor issues such as improper case closure through the "end-of-trial" procedure and overdue distribution of enforcement proceeds, conduct self-inspections and mutual evaluations of case closures, improve and implement the "One Case One Account" working mechanism. Strengthen checks and oversight of enforcement powers, implement and refine opinions on strengthening enforcement supervision, deepen the separation of enforcement adjudication powers from enforcement implementation powers, strengthen the supervisory responsibilities of intermediate courts, and promote the in-depth development of the "Three Unifications" management mechanism. Further strengthen the informatization of enforcement, expand and upgrade system functions, strengthen the management of enforcement nodes, and enhance the automation and intelligence level of enforcement process supervision. Further strengthen the standardization of enforcement, cooperate with the legislative work on the Enforcement Law, accelerate the drafting and revision of judicial interpretations on the enforcement of claims and the list of dishonest judgment debtors, and improve the system of enforcement laws and regulations. Adhere to enforcement with good faith and civility according to law, and balance the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of all parties.

IV. Consolidate and Improve the Achievements of People's Tribunal Construction, Continuously Strengthen the Grassroots Foundation

17. Strive to promote new improvements in people's tribunal construction. Effectively treat it as a "top priority project," improve mechanisms such as regular investigation and research and setting up contact points, deepen the understanding of the laws of grassroots justice, better implement the principles of "Three Conveniences" and "Three Services," and improve the people's tribunal system in the new era. Carefully review the reform and construction of people's tribunals, effectively address problems such as unbalanced development, unclear functional positioning, and inadequate management and support in some areas. Strengthen the selection and compilation of typical cases of people's tribunal construction in the new era, explore and promote successful experiences in people's tribunal construction, and break the "waiting, relying, and demanding" mindset of some local courts. Accelerate the construction of a one-stop service for people's tribunals, improve mechanisms for direct case-filing or dispatched case-filing, promote cross-regional case-filing services, explore direct enforcement mechanisms, comprehensively solve the difficulty of service of process, and provide equal and inclusive litigation services to grassroots and rural people. Improve the personnel management mechanism, promote the allocation of staffing and judge quotas to the grassroots and front-line trial departments, establish a regular job rotation mechanism, strengthen trial support, and encourage standardized and orderly procurement of social services. Strengthen the construction and application of the "Two Platforms" of the people's tribunal work platform and information platform, improve guarantees in infrastructure, business equipment, informatization construction, funding, and other aspects, and strengthen the security work of people's tribunals.

18. Strive to achieve new results in serving the work related to agriculture, rural areas, and farmers. Serve the effective connection between consolidating and expanding the achievements of poverty alleviation and rural revitalization, lawfully and properly handle cases involving rural land system reform, factor guarantees for agricultural and rural development, urban-rural economic cycles, demolition and land acquisition, etc., safeguard agricultural and rural reform, and promote the development of the agricultural industry. Effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of farmers, lawfully adjudicate cases involving disputes over the "separation of three rights" of rural land, and protect the added value income, equity income, and asset income of farmers' collectives and individuals. Promote the implementation of equal employment and equal pay for equal work for urban and rural workers, and protect the payment of wages and other labor rights of migrant workers according to law. Focus on the improvement of rural living environment, and leverage judicial functions to promote the resolution of rural environmental issues.

19. Strive to expand new avenues for serving grassroots social governance. Adhere to and develop the "Fengqiao Experience" in the new era, create a number of "Fengqiao-style People's Tribunals," actively integrate into the grassroots governance system led by the Party committee, combine strengthening the construction of people's tribunals to promote the mediation platform of the People's Courts to enter villages, communities, and grids, and promote the discovery, mediation, and resolution of conflicts and disputes on the spot. Strengthen the source governance of frequent and typical localized disputes, strengthen coordination and cooperation with townships, sub-districts, and comprehensive management centers, timely grasp and assess the situation of conflicts and disputes, better serve the scientific decision-making of the Party committee and government, and promote the resolution of grassroots disputes at their source. Inherit and develop the "Ma Xiwu Trial Method," adhere to the combination of online and offline, use forms such as vehicle court and backpack court to go deep into villages, communities, enterprises, and areas with inconvenient transportation, and provide high-quality judicial services to grassroots people.

V. Consolidating and Enhancing the Achievements of Judicial Reform to Better Achieve Systemic Integration, Coordination, and Efficiency

20. Adhering to the Correct Direction of Judicial Reform. We shall persist in combining top-level design with "crossing the river by feeling the stones", give full play to the leading, demonstrative, breakthrough, and driving roles of pilot projects, and promptly elevate effective reform measures into institutional rules. We shall adhere to a systemic perspective, coordinate and advance key reforms and critical links, including the reform of the judicial accountability system, the trial-centered litigation system reform, the implementation of the three trial procedures, the circuit court reform, and the pilot reform of the functional positioning of courts at four levels, and effectively transform institutional design into momentum for improving the quality and efficiency of trial and enforcement. We shall carefully summarize the experience and achievements of reform, persistently use reform-oriented thinking and methods to solve difficult problems, address new challenges, shore up weak points, and strengthen areas of deficiency, promote the reform to achieve more tangible results, and continuously enhance the people's sense of gain.

21. Effectively Consolidating the Achievements of One-Stop Construction. We shall leverage the integrating role of one-stop construction to ensure that various reforms, such as the case-filing register system reform, litigation system reform, and the reform to improve the functional positioning of courts at four levels, are coordinated, integrated, and efficient within the one-stop framework, continuously improving the effectiveness of dispute resolution and the quality of litigation services. Focusing on the concepts of one-stop, intensive, integrated, online, and convergent, we shall accelerate the extension of one-stop construction to the grassroots level, to society, to online platforms, and to key industries and fields. We shall adhere to the value orientation of openness and integration, remove bottlenecks that hinder joint construction, shared governance, and common benefits, and improve the work pattern for the prevention and resolution of disputes at their source.

22. Correctly Implementing the Amended Civil Procedure Law. We shall accelerate the revision of supporting judicial interpretations, guide people's courts at all levels to accurately grasp the spirit of the amended law, and strictly implement the new rules and requirements. Focusing on key issues such as the identification of simple and complex cases, the application of procedural diversion, the coordinated allocation of resources, diversified dispute resolution, and case quality supervision, we shall improve supporting mechanisms and measures, and promote the establishment of a multi-dimensional, multi-level, and refined civil litigation procedure system. We shall coordinately advance institutional improvement, procedural guarantees, and efficiency enhancement, placing greater emphasis on case quality and the protection of rights.

VI. Consolidating and Enhancing the Achievements of Smart Court Construction to Create a Higher Level of Digital Justice

23. Deepening Innovation in Online Litigation Models and Rules. We shall strictly implement the rules on online litigation, online mediation, and the operation of people's courts online, comprehensively considering factors such as the parties' willingness, the nature and characteristics of the case, and information technology conditions, to reasonably and accurately apply the online trial mechanism, protect the parties' right to know and right to choose, and better release the "digital dividend". We shall not violate the principles of due process due to changes in trial methods or environments, ensuring that online litigation "reduces costs without reducing quality, and improves efficiency without diminishing rights". We shall deepen the construction of internet courts, promote the improvement of the establishment model and case jurisdiction scope of internet courts, and give full play to the leading and exemplary role of internet courts in establishing rules, improving systems, and governing cyberspace.

24. Expanding the Application Scenarios of Information Technology in the Judicial Field. We shall adhere to technology-driven development, promote the application of emerging technologies such as 5G, blockchain, and artificial intelligence, improve various platform systems, and effectively address issues such as platform fragmentation, data silos, operational inconvenience, and information security. We shall adhere to a systemic perspective, strengthen top-level design and technological breakthroughs, focus on pilot demonstrations and collaborative innovation, and promote the mutual traction and iterative development of information technology and trial and enforcement operations.

25. Actively Participating in and Promoting Digital Governance. We shall vigorously advance scientific and technological innovation in people's courts, fully utilize the Smart Court Laboratory to strengthen research on key core technologies. We shall fully exploit the advantages of massive judicial big data, strengthen in-depth research and judgment of key cases in relevant fields, and provide decision-making references for analyzing economic and social development trends, strengthening dispute resolution, and providing early warning of economic risks. We shall strengthen exchanges and cooperation with relevant departments and research institutions, enhance information sharing and business coordination, improve governance rules, codes of conduct, rights boundaries, and responsibility systems, and promote the modernization of the digital economy governance system and governance capacity.

VII. Consolidating and Enhancing the Achievements of Party History Learning and Education and Team Education and Rectification to Forge a Loyal, Clean, and Responsible Court Iron Army

26. Continuously Cementing Political Loyalty. We shall always place the Party's political construction in the first position, promote the normalization of the "Two Upholds" thematic education, and organize the thematic education on "Deeply Understanding the Decisive Significance of the 'Two Establishments' and Resolutely Achieving the 'Two Upholds'". We shall improve the system of political rotation training, make Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law the core course and mandatory content of education and training, tell vivid stories of the practice of Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, and guide the vast number of judicial police to unswervingly walk the path of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics. We shall carry forward the great spirit of Party building, establish a normalized and long-term mechanism for Party history learning and education, deepen political education, warning education, and exemplary role model education, and educate and guide judicial police to forever maintain the political character of loyalty to the Party. We shall thoroughly and completely eliminate the pernicious influence of Zhou Yongkang, Sun Lijun, and others, deeply learn from the negative lessons of Xi Xiaoming, Zhang Jian, Zhang Jiahui, Meng Xiang, Wang Linqing, and other negative examples, and focus on purifying the political ecosystem.

27. Improving Team Quality and Capability. We shall strengthen the construction of the leading bodies of people's courts, give full play to the role of the "key minority", take the lead in shouldering heavy burdens, daring to struggle, and exercising strict self-discipline. We shall strengthen training for newly appointed court presidents and members of leading bodies, enhancing their ability to promote the high-quality development of the work of people's courts in the new era. We shall adhere to the orientation of practical combat, practical use, and practical effect, improve the mechanism for cultivating high-quality professional talents, strengthen talent construction in important positions and key fields, and deeply promote the tiered cultivation of trial business experts. We shall improve the whole-chain mechanism for selecting, nurturing, managing, and using young talents, allowing young judicial police to experience challenges, gain exposure, strengthen their bones, and grow their abilities on the front line of major struggles. We shall coordinate training in political ability, professional ethics, professional skills, and comprehensive qualities, increase support for judicial capacity building in the western and ethnic minority regions, and comprehensively enhance the performance ability of judicial police in the new era. We shall strengthen the cultural construction of people's courts, produce more excellent cultural works of the court, promote the development of court museum and cultural heritage, use excellent culture to cultivate virtue and talent, and better promote the socialist spirit of the rule of law. We shall enhance security work capabilities, implement the safety responsibility system, strengthen measures of "human defense, physical defense, and technical defense" to ensure trial safety, enforcement safety, personal safety of judicial police, court premises safety, people's safety, and party safety. We shall strengthen news and publicity work, improve the ability and level of court news and public opinion work, grasp the timing, intensity, and effect of work, and create a good public opinion atmosphere for handling cases according to law.

28. Deepening the Construction of Party Conduct and Integrity. We shall consolidate the main responsibility of the Party for strict governance over the Party, make good use of the results of team education and rectification, improve institutional mechanisms such as education management, early warning and prevention, supervision and punishment, and institutional constraints, and advance in an integrated manner the goal of ensuring that officials do not dare to be corrupt, cannot be corrupt, and do not want to be corrupt. We shall conscientiously implement the spirit of the Central Committee's Eight-Point Regulation and its implementing rules, adhere to the "Three Stricts and Three Honests", conduct in-depth investigation and research, speak honest words, do honest things, be honest people, resolutely oppose the "four forms of decadence", especially formalism and bureaucracy, and implement various regulations to reduce burdens at the grassroots level. We shall combine the implementation of the implementing regulations of the Supervision Law to conduct in-depth integrity education, carry out integrity culture education, and make judicial police know reverence, maintain caution, and hold the bottom line. We shall insist on turning the knife inward and scraping the poison off the bone, strictly enforce ironclad rules and prohibitions such as the "Three Rules" on preventing interference in judicial work and the "Ten Prohibitions" for political and legal police in the new era, severely punish judicial corruption with zero tolerance, and resolutely eliminate the black sheep. We shall adhere to the combination of strict management and loving care, improve the guarantee mechanism for performing duties according to law, introduce more policies and measures to provide special care, support judges in strictly and impartially administering justice, do everything possible to solve practical difficulties, and truly enable judicial police to feel secure, at ease, and engaged in their work.

VIII. Consciously Accepting Supervision and Continuously Improving the Work of People's Courts

29. Innovating Forms to Actively Accept Supervision. We shall enhance the awareness of consciously accepting supervision, improve the working mechanism for communication and liaison with deputies and committee members, innovate ways and means of liaison and communication, carry out liaison and communication work efficiently and conveniently, and unblock channels for public opinion. We shall actively invite National People's Congress deputies to inspect court work, attend meetings, and observe trials, listen carefully to their opinions and suggestions on court work. We shall actively visit and receive members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), strengthen communication with democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party personages, and widely adopt opinions from all sides. We shall conscientiously handle deputies' suggestions and CPPCC proposals, strengthen supervision and urging, timely report to deputies and committee members on the progress and effectiveness of handling, and actively strive for their understanding and support. We shall carefully prepare for the special report on foreign-related trial work to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, conduct in-depth investigation and research, comprehensively listen to opinions and suggestions, and promote the improvement of foreign-related judicial capacity and level.

People's courts at all levels shall, based on these Key Points, combine them with actual work, break down the tasks, and vigorously implement the work. They shall earnestly fulfill their duties and tasks of maintaining national political security, ensuring overall social stability, promoting social fairness and justice, and ensuring the people's peaceful life. They shall strive to promote the high-quality development of the work of people's courts in the new era, provide strong judicial services for achieving the second centenary goal, and welcome the successful convening of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China with concrete actions!
